Forwarding fixed + multi-hop test added. dao_parents_for_source (rust/lichen-node/src/routing/router.rs:1134) was already reworked (uncommitted, from earlier session) to parse \u00a78.7.1 generalized Target bodies inline (flags+prefix_len+ceil(plen/8) octets, canonicalized, /0 fail-closed) with group flush on target-after-transit, replacing RplTarget::from_bytes; I verified it against root extract_updates semantics and left it intact. I added 5 tests in routing/tests.rs (generalized /64 group matching source; every transit parent collected for a group; /60 host-bit canonicalization before matching; /0 + truncated-body + orphan-transit fail-closed; dangling trailing group is permissive-by-design, root extract_updates rejects it) and the required end-to-end regression in node.rs: grouped_delegated_prefix_dao_is_forwarded_by_parent_and_processed_by_root \u2014 leaf two hops from root sends signed DAO with self-/128 + delegated-/64 in one target group; non-root parent forwards it (DaoForwarded next_hop=root), wrong-IID sender dropped, forwarded bytes intact, root ingests Applied with delegation provisioned (root.router.dao_manager.delegate_prefix) and installs routes for both leaf /128 and delegated /64. Evidence: cargo test -p lichen-node --lib targeted 8/8 pass; full lichen-node 266/267 (sole failure secure.rs secure_block1_and_block2_roundtrip = concurrent in-flight lichen-oscore work, files unmodified by this issue, HEAD baseline does not compile); lichen-rpl 299 passed 0 failed (no regression); cargo fmt -p lichen-node --check clean; clippy: zero new warnings from touched files (2 pre-existing at HEAD: secure.rs:642 too_many_arguments, tests.rs:2319 redundant closure).
